title: Social Media Advertising - Worldwide
highlights: Ad spending in the Social Media Advertising market worldwide is projected to reach US$338.75bn in 2026.
This ad spending is expected to exhibit an annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2031) of 11.46%, leading to a projected market volume of US$582.63bn by 2031.
In a global context, the majority of ad spending will be generated United States, which is expected to reach US$126.00bn in 2026.
Within the Social Media Advertising market, it is anticipated that 83.0% of total ad spending will be generated through mobile by 2031.
Furthermore, the number of users in the Social Media Advertising market is expected to amount to 6.89bn users by 2031.
Worldwide, social media advertising is increasingly leveraging advanced algorithms to enhance targeting precision and improve user engagement across diverse platforms.
